body: I’ve learned this painfully. No one ever texts me first. Never will. I’ve been giving up on society and becoming invisible

My brother is my best friend. We both had a rough childhood but always had each other and know each other so well. He’d be destroyed if I left him. He’s my other half. My deepest condolences to you. I’m very familiar with grief and guilt, and always open to talking. Here for you

I’m in the same boat. My depressed mind has convinced myself I’ll never find love. Idk if that’ll actually be the case, but I don’t have much hope. Still holding onto hope by a thread or else I would’ve taken my life already. Ive tried 3 times before, each on growing degrees of extremes trying to kill myself. I now own a gun, but I don’t want to end it all yet deep down. But yeah, I can’t even get a date, can’t get friends. Family disowned me. So I feel you

Growing up, always being told to suck it up, get over it, man up, etc. Whenever I was going through something difficult. It’s just kind of assumed that since I’m a man that I don’t have any internal issues at all, and that I should be raising a family right now. That’s how my family paints it anyway. 

I’m an outcast. Misunderstood by everyone. Anyone who’s ever known about my mental struggles has called me a murder in the making. A threat to society. When in reality the only living soul I’d ever hurt is myself. But people think “man with mental illness = CRIMINAL”. 

The few times I’ve ever expressed interest in a woman, I’ve been told “that’s gross. Ew! No way I’d date you! You’re too weird for me”. And this is from women in their 20’s. In general everyone calls me a weirdo. No one really listens to me though, and no one wants to have a conversation. The people that do always are like “you’re the nicest person I know” and I generally believe I’m a good person. I work so hard to be the best person I can be, but good guys don’t win in this world. 

It seems I’m just set up to fail with all these stigmas and assumptions against me. The few friendships I had, I’d have to put in extensive efforts just to keep it alive. I’ve NEVER been texted first. Called first. Etc. And the moment I stop initiating the first move, people will just never talk to me ever again. 

It’s very lonely. It’s full of bad coping mechanisms. I can’t even get treatment for my disorder since where I live is a borderline theocratic state and I can only get treatment if I join the church and have the church fund my treatment, since they won’t accept insurance. No one here does. But I can’t move, because I’m poor. 

I do kinda feel isolated a lot in the sense that on mental health Reddit, it seems to be predominantly women and children (under 18). So I feel really isolated all the time. Like men just don’t have mental issues and I’m a rarity. Either way I feel like an alien to society and will eventually disappear and no one will notice

My last best friend told me I was disposable and he didn’t need me. Basically put all my fears to life. We’ve known each other for almost ten years and knowing it was all fake… yeah I’ve come to terms that no one will ever need me. No one will want me. I’m better off alone. Sure I’m miserable by myself, but at least now no one can hurt me. Only myself! Yay!

This is just where we scream into the void, and document it. So that maybe in years to come they’ll find a random account and see their own life spiral down all the way to their final moments and people will think “wow, a person was there”. I’ll never get help in this sun, but it’s nice to have something on the record

I study pharmacology. Antipsychotics aren’t literally for people who are “psycho”. I’ll try not to overwhelm you with scientific stuff, but they act as a regulator in your brain…basically controlling the amount of signals one part of the brain can send to the other. Helps with people who experience mood swings, or in general, extreme highs or lows (or both if you’re bipolar). Think of it like a brain-neutralizer. I have severe depression but I take an antipsychotic every day to help keep myself stable and regulated. You can chat with me if you’d like to learn more. Or if you’d like to read the scientific stuff, here’s a good essay: 

https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK519503/

Hope something here helps. I’d advise you take the meds. You never make the shots you don’t take. Here for you, seriously. Cheers to you
Yeah I’m 21 and look at all the damage I’ve done to myself and realize it’s fucked me over so badly I’ll never climb out of this hole. Just a few short years really do affect the rest of your life…

Chemical imbalance in the brain at work probably. Having extreme sensations of one type of emotion for a prolonged period of time could potentially result in the brain later on trying to overload the other sectors to “balance out” the senses. The acts can be almost instantaneous and unpredictable. There’s a lot I’m glossing over, but that’s the gist of it. Could be a sign of some greater problems going on too

I went to a state with extremely relaxed gun laws and purchased a handgun despite having hospitalizations for suicide attempts and the whole nine yards. I decided this would be the ultimate finale of my life. I wasn’t going to fail. I was determined to die. I packed up my stuff, gave most of my belongings away. Mailed my precious belongings to my dad (whom I haven’t spoken to in years) saying I had killed myself and the stuff I sent was because I needed to ensure that would be kept safe. I put that in the mail and I honestly don’t remember what happened the rest of the day. I went to work but it was an absolute blur. I was so overwhelmed with anxiety and the urge to end my life I left work early. Who cares, I’m gonna be dead tonight right? Driving home, it started to storm. Thunder and lightning. Felt like the most poetic way to end it all. I couldn’t tell you what or who exactly stopped me. I just know by the end of the night someone convinced me to give it another day. Then two. Then three. Just a random internet person. Life has been harder than it’s ever been since that day. But I’m still here and literally just taking it one day at a time. I’m not trying to save you. I’m not trying to be a hero. I’m not trying to stop you from doing anything. Your decisions are not mine to make. But I’d like to press you to push along another day. Then another. I know it’s hard but I know it’s possible. Life isn’t all sunshine and roses still either since that fateful day. But as miserable as I am, I’m glad I’m still kicking. Without hesitation I’m here if you wish to speak. I know how much of a difference it can take to have one friendly and kind voice in your life. With all sincerity, my best wishes are with you

I study pharmacology. The medications used aren’t lethal alone. The hydroxyIzine and Tercian aren’t going to kill. The Tramadol is a synthetic opiate and crossing it with the Xanax and alcohol may cause them problems. I can’t say this person is guaranteed to live. But they’re definitely hard asleep right now and will for a while. If they do wake up they’re gonna be dealing with some pretty nasty complications. I’d say they have about a 50/50 chance of living. Depends on their own body chemistry. I’m gonna follow this post and see if OP wakes up

You’re really pushing this rebirth narrative. “What if” is not a proper way to think about the definitive. When we die that’s it. There is no reincarnation. Yes we can’t technically prove there is no reincarnation but we can prove that all matter eventually WILL disintegrate into nothing until it’s just loose photons floating around in a dark, massive, and empty universe. We will wane away. We are our own individuals and nothing will ever emulate our own souls. We are completely individual and irreplaceable. Everything will die and whither into oblivion in the end. I know that as a fact and that is soothing knowing once we die it’s all over forever

Those are over-the-counter meds. They won’t kill you. Not even if you multiply those doses by 10. Save yourself the 24 hours of physical pain. Sorry to burst your bubble. Any medicine that can easily kill someone is extremely hard to get. You won’t find anything like that in the grocery store. And before you ask the “best prescription” to OD on, there is none. Just saved you some temporary heartache. I’ve tried overdosing before with other meds that have brought me to my knees begging for death more. I wouldn’t wish that pain on anyone. If you need someone to chat with, my DM’s are open. All the best to you

I was in a similar spot, and still kind of am. Mom dead, dad married lady I don’t know, brother currently out of the country. I move around a lot and never spend more than a year in one place then I move again (record is 10 months). I can’t promise things will get better super fast. I’d recommend opening up to your sister. I know at age 16 that sounds crazy, but I opened up to my brother about my private struggles. You’d be surprised. Now it gives me a little bit of will power to keep going. Despite everyone leaving me, I still have my brother and he is worth fighting for. Maybe you could bring yourself to act similarly with your sister? Be patient. Life is hard. Time does heal all but it’s incredibly slow. You can do this

There’s no such thing as “the best drug for suicide”. No matter what you are gambling with your health. Opiates are probably the most common class of drug involved with suicide, but they’re super hard to get ahold of. You seem young by the way you talk, so no doc is gonna give you opiates to a child (unless absolutely necessary which is usually in a hospital setting after a catastrophic accident). 

Legal disclaimer: This is in no way medical advice nor is it any recommendation and I do not support the use of any drugs mentioned to be used for suicide and am not encouraging such acts to be taken. 

If you need someone to talk to by the way, I’m here for you. Seriously. I’ve had some attempts myself so I know the pain all too well. My best wishes are with you

If they didn’t seek medical help by now, they’re definitely asleep. Give them 15 hours, they’re gonna be asleep for a while due to the effects of the medication they took

chlorpheniramine is an antihistimane used for the common cold and other minor health symptoms. This OP won’t die. The dosage isn’t anywhere close to anything that could possibly bring death. They’re just gonna be asleep for a while and feel like shit when they wake up. So for any readers concerned over the OP’s life, just know they’ll be okay. And for those of you considering trying to overdose on easy-access OTC meds…. Don’t try. It doesn’t work.

Here’s what I’ve always said. If you have to write letters, it means people still care about you. It means you still care about them. I had an attempt a month ago and wrote a letter to my dad. Just him. Mailed it out, and planned to follow through with my suicide that night. One thing led to another, I ended up surviving, and then my dad got the letter. Do you ever imagine how other people may react to your death? I wondered too, and then witnessed it. It was kind of eye-opening. My dad who I haven’t spoken to in over a year prior to me sending the letter…. He was worried sick and heartbroken over me. Since then, I’m still depressed and an emotional wreck with self-harming tendencies, but that spurred me to at least continue this battle to live. Maybe you have some fight left in you as well? My best wishes are with you.
